folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B303: trial mechanisms, source scope and genuine consequences
folds.body:
The full original 233-line palette was reviewed. Weibao's world-dependent intensity and all-supported-possibilities answers are recorded, not new questions. The NovelConcept/DeathaDay table attributes twelve feature groups to existing local notes; the other eleven franchise/myth rows are explicitly recall leads. This pass rereads neither primary chapters nor those notes. A table of remembered trials cannot establish exact threshold, true-name, title, ritual or return law for another world.

Trigger, pending obligation, actual trial entry, place/time context, examiner, participants, target, result and afterward are different owners. Source-backed body/soul/item/territory attachment decides whether a pending threat travels or remains. Delay-not-cancel, none-free bypass, threshold danger, more severe repeats and diminishing reward are illustrative local policies, including the possibility of true cancellation or free protection by actual means. A powerful faculty need not acquire a new tax to keep a trial interesting. Simulated histories can produce an authored real consequence, but their fictional events do not become actual campaign history or crime evidence merely because a trial displays them.

A partial clear, survival, distinction, refusal and terminal result need their actual declared effects. The never-pointless wording is a design aspiration, not an automatic lesson/XP/title reward for every failed or unseen event. A retry is a new source-legal attempt; displaying or resettling an old clear does not pay again. An examiner's judgment, audience, bribe, insurance and remembered strategy need real actors, knowledge and resources. They do not make every institution corrupt, every trial adaptive or the player personally judged by development-only state.

A place-rule layer or shared trial engine can supply selected plumbing, without forcing a riddle, mental examination, exam and physical arena through identical spatial/combat semantics. Existing pledges and progression consumers qualify the old missing-queue/menu/space assertions through [the high-tier corrections](HIGH_TIER_POWER_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-23.md) and [gate owner](PROGRESSION_GATE_RULES.md). Their existence does not prove this whole palette or all native/persistence behavior. Existing source/destination, actual body/cargo, chosen response windows and owner publication remain necessary for a selected real consumer.

Wait/auto-run/harsh forced-trial options do not silently change current world clocks, character-important pause or closed-browser policy. A written away-growth or penalty possibility is not a request for offline processing or caretaker debt. Personal/raw intensity uses the fictional character's supported in-game records, not Weibao's actual personal life. Recognition/replay/trial disclosures remain subject to each actual observer and sealed route. Current book-world/menu priority, compatibility and delivery floor govern new work; no universal trial migration, live queue, source truth, offline behavior or new Frontier slice is selected or verified here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B303: index boundary and current entry owners
folds.body:
All original 194 lines were reviewed: D1–D7, every source-local prefix/default, C1–C11, V1–V5, all ten ranked candidates and later routing/launch notices. This is a full index read, not a read of the 2,200-line intro owner or its linked sources/reports by proxy. Its rounds1–16 boundary explicitly excludes later appendices, even when pointers describe rounds24–28. Current [world-entry rules](WORLD_ENTRY_RULES.md), [developer/player scope](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) and project authority determine present direction. The three obsolete PROJECT UI-summary anchors are repaired to its standing-priority/authority section, with exact old targets preserved in the amendment ledger.

Keep the useful distinctions in its tensions: None can filter the offered experience without rewriting world truth; past characters, present bodies and alternative people are not one record; retained history and an actionable branch restore differ; a canon role can fail for lack of actual means, while a specifically admitted developer canon policy follows its own scope. Fate/correction/substitution needs the named world's mechanism and actual detection/cost, not a forced replacement because a plot outline expects someone. C4–C9 are historical proposed-policy tensions, not eleven current confirmed bugs or new decisions for Weibao. Actual local retention and clock/absence laws remain in their current owners.

V1's dev-probe receipt retains both the original false import PASS and the repaired/refrozen actual export/file-input import. The final result does not erase the failure. Its isolated Village entry is not a production random pool, full all-world start flow or present main integration. V2/V3's derivation/override pure modules and test suites do not supply a native branch/role/motive/window/persistence consumer. V4's 33-event/five-anchor research graph and 8/4/1 skip scenarios are finite comparisons, with MTL fidelity and real-clock/positive-fixed-role limits retained. V5's 51 source tests do not establish closed-tab equivalence. Old viewport, fresh-save and byte assertions remain bound to their recorded inputs. No bundle, screenshot, source or test was reopened here.

Preserve unknowns as unknown: incomplete MoL/identity/canon pilots at this date do not prove their current absence or waive exact current evidence. The 57-work/33-kind catalog and 35-case/16-pattern research counts are not qualified playable starts. Dated recommendations for three routes, profile/branch stores, offline ledgers, two-rung role ladders, inheritance and body comparisons remain options. The later launch-layout study is explicitly fixture/proposal work, not native start effects. Known lower-spoiler ordinary starts, meaningful first actions and broad source-world possibilities survive without selecting an equal-world distribution, automatic reroll, universal unlock ladder or every prerequisite store.

Current AD51 permits a justified first useful shared seam, AD52 preserves meaningful choice while compressing repetition, and the lead route builds for ordinary/alternative lives rather than setting player identity. Compatibility follows the selected current decision, not a universal historical-save migration promise in P6. Old paused/fresh/frozen-world examples do not authorize new catch-up or revive compulsory Village/Frontier depth. No start is chosen, rolled, researched, implemented or accepted by this documentation pass.
